bio: U.S. Representative for Florida's 19th congressional district since 2021, previously serving in the Florida House of Representatives from 2016 to 2020. Raised in Brooklyn by a single mother, he graduated from Florida State University with a degree in finance and marketing before working in banking and insurance in Southwest Florida. He won the Republican nomination for governor in the August 2026 primary.

An attorney and former Republican member of Congress who represented the Tampa Bay area from 2014 to 2017, Jolly later registered as an independent before joining the Democratic Party in 2025. He has worked as a television political analyst and campaign finance reform advocate. He won the Democratic nomination for governor in the August 2026 primary, running alongside former Congresswoman Gwen Graham.

Incumbent Florida Attorney General, appointed to the role by Governor Ron DeSantis in early 2025 after previously serving as the governor's chief of staff. A graduate of the University of Florida and Georgetown University Law Center, he is now seeking his first full term in the November 2026 general election.

A Miami attorney and former Florida legislator, having served in the state House from 2012 to 2016 and the state Senate from 2016 to 2020. He later served as a U.S. Assistant Secretary of Labor. A graduate of Brown University and Harvard Law School, he is the Democratic nominee for Florida Attorney General in the November 2026 general election.
